import sys

def main():
    t = int(input().strip())
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input().strip())
        matches = []
        for _ in range(2 * n * (2 * n - 1)):
            line = input().strip().split()
            matches.append((int(line[1]), int(line[2])))
        
        # Simulate the matches to determine the order of strengths
        strengths = list(range(1, 2 * n + 1))
        for i, j in matches:
            if i > j:
                strengths[i - 1], strengths[j - 1] = strengths[j - 1], strengths[i - 1]
        
        # Print the order of strengths
        print("! " + " ".join(map(str, strengths[:n])))
        input().strip()  # Read the exclamation mark

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
